metadata.title: [Bug report] error when using weight_norm and DataParallel at the same time.

trigger_conditions.condition: Create a zero-dimensional parameter, such as through weight_norm(dim=None), and exercise module replication across devices.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Use torch.nn.utils.weight_norm(module, dim=None), which produces a 0-dim weight_g parameter, then wrap the model with torch.nn.DataParallel and run forward/backward on multiple CUDA devices.

failure_behavior.description: Use torch.nn.utils.weight_norm(module, dim=None), which produces a 0-dim weight_g parameter, then wrap the model with torch.nn.DataParallel and run forward/backward on multiple CUDA devices.
